body.name: External-margin redundancy handle
body.construction: Pointwise in \(\delta\), compare \(\mathcal P_\delta(b,q,\omega)\) with the substituted fiber \(\mathcal P_\delta(b,q^{\mathrm{case}},\omega)\) by paired primal endpoint programs and their linear-program duals. Upon failure of endpoint invariance, the certificate reports exactly one exhaustive branch: a Farkas ray if the substituted fiber is empty; if it is nonempty and the ratio is nonconstant, two substituted-fiber compatible-law lifts with distinct ratio values plus an attaining primal endpoint law and matching dual bound that prove a strict mismatch with an original endpoint; or, if it is nonempty but ratio-constant, a primal compatible-law witness and matching dual endpoint bound proving that its singleton ratio set differs from the original sharp set. The last branch includes a singleton substituted fiber.
